PORT.description: The port Trivy server listens on. Railway automatically maps this to the public domain.

TRIVY_CACHE_BACKEND.description: Cache backend for vulnerability database. 'fs' stores the cache locally (no extra service needed). Set to 'redis://redis:6379' if you deploy a Redis companion.

TRIVY_LISTEN.description: Listen address for the Trivy server. Must match the PORT above.

TRIVY_SKIP_DB_UPDATE.description: Set to 'true' to skip automatic vulnerability database updates on startup. Not recommended for production use.

TRIVY_DB_REPOSITORY.description: OCI repository to retrieve the vulnerability database from. Change this if your region has issues with the default mirror.

TRIVY_SCANNERS.description: Scanner types to enable. Comma-separated: vuln, misconfig, secret, license. Defaults cover all scan types.
